description: Strigolactones are hydrophobic apocarotenoids with relatively high soil sorption and rapid biodegradation, potentially restricting effective free diffusion distances in mineral soils compared to porous artificial substrates.
resolution: Adjudicated: Diffusion across 0.45 um membranes in washed quartz substrate confirms chemical sufficiency in pore water; in agronomic field soils, free diffusion operates over micro-zones (< 5-10 mm), whereas Common Mycorrhizal Networks (M2 conduit) extend functional signaling distances across decimeters.

description: Pi-replete plants maintain high intracellular 1,5-InsP8 levels that bind SPX proteins to repress PHR transcription factors, which normally suppresses mycorrhizal symbiosis.
resolution: Adjudicated: Exogenous strigolactone perception via TaD14 directly targets the TaD53 repressor for proteasomal degradation, bypassing SPX-mediated inhibition of PHR and directly derepressing symbiosis accommodation genes including TaPT4.

description: Unstressed recipient plants allocating carbon (hexose and fatty acids) to AM fungi prior to nutrient limitation could theoretically experience a transient growth penalty.
resolution: Adjudicated: Empirical shoot phosphorus data demonstrate that enhanced Pi uptake (+0.87 mg/g DW) rapidly offsets fungal carbon costs without biomass penalty under high-density canopy conditions.
